result.reason: The redline reaches the fallback by changing only the notice period from 90 to 60 days. The fixed economic terms renew without an authorized uplift, so the effective renewal increase is 0%. It does not satisfy the preferred position because Customer must give 60 rather than 30 days' notice and no Vendor reminder is required. The drafting is serviceable but uses general termination language rather than clearly tying notice to non-renewal at an anniversary, which creates some ambiguity.
